name: ScaleLong
abstract: ScaleLong targets long-video understanding with multi-timescale reasoning. This page uses the Overall score from the main result table.
method: This work decomposes long-video understanding into multiple timescales such as clip, shot, event, and story, while covering diverse task types.
It emphasizes that models must not only perceive local clips, but also integrate events and narratives over long horizons.
The main results show stronger overall performance for leading closed-source models, yet long-video reasoning remains difficult, especially at the story level.
